{{Top|leg}}
'''Monofilament fibers''' were needle sharp strands that were virtually invisible. They used in [[Menendahl Cybertronics]]' [[cybernetic nexus ring]]. Chemically coated and one [[Meter/Legends|meter]] in length, the fiber has a standard [[energy jack connector]] at one end, allowing it to connect to local power sources. Monofilament fibers were also integral components in [[Novaplex/Legends|Novaplex's]] [[monofilament screen guard]]s.
